title: Aerodynamic car study
description: A form study reworking a sports saloon, adjusting fourteen details of the body towards better aerodynamics.
summary: A form study reworking a sports saloon, adjusting fourteen details of the bodywork towards better aerodynamics.
heroAlt: Pencil rendering of the car with coloured ribbons tracing airflow across the body
cardAlt: Pencil rendering of the reworked car form

chapters.heading: The brief
body: The exercise takes an existing sports saloon as its starting point, finds the places where the form is fighting the air, and draws a proposal that answers them.
The whole study was done by hand, concentrating on reading the form rather than simulating it.

chapters.heading: Fourteen changes
body: The coloured ribbons on the drawing trace where the air goes: over the roof, along the flanks, into the intakes and out past the tail.
points: Air curtains and front bumper vents
Redrawn front bumper and radiator grille
Lowered bonnet with added cooling slots
Shallower windscreen angle and a domed roof line
Fastback tail with a deployable ducktail spoiler
Side intakes and vents behind the wheel arch
